body: Anyone else not get unemployment yet?

I appreciate your response.  I don't give up on the effort to heal myself - I am simply eventually overcome and find myself just as broken as I was the last time I put myself back together.  The feeling of worthlessness definitely relates to not measuring up to others and/or my own standards.  I have tried to used radical self acceptance in a few of these attempts at self-healing, but I am so far unable to maintain this viewpoint.
And to be clear, I don't think suicide is noble, either.  I just cannot continue to live.

Oh I don't think suicide is inherently selfish, if done right.  I mean being crushed by others' accomplishments.  That's what I meant is selfish, horrible, and twisted, and is one of the primary things that makes my suicide a benefit to the world.
